entities.description: A woman with dark skin and short curly hair is holding a sleeping baby wrapped in a white knitted blanket. She is wearing a colorful patterned dress with red, green, yellow, and black geometric designs, and has a black camera with a lens hanging from a strap around her neck. The background shows a dirt ground with some rocks and a stone wall.

entities.description: A close-up crop of a person's head wearing a vibrant, patterned headscarf wrapped in a turban style. The fabric features a bold, multicolored print with large, abstract shapes in red, yellow, green, and black, resembling a traditional African wax print or Ankara style. The person's forehead and closed eyes are visible at the bottom of the frame, showing dark skin and a serene expression.
